outcome: Prevalence of type 1 diabetes in pregnancy
cohort: 70 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes mellitus who gave birth at a tertiary perinatal center.
finding: Pregnancies complicated by type 1 diabetes mellitus were associated with significantly higher rates of large for gestational age infants, macrosomia, deliveries at 37-39 weeks, and cesarean sections.
birth_weight: Newborns of mothers with DM type 1: 3650±605g, newborns of mothers without DM type 1: 3428±591g
